description: Edge-Based Distribution Grid Simulation and Congestion Management is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mehdi Attar (Tampere University). Docker Compose release This release provides a validated Docker Compose deployment for the complete edge-based distribution-grid monitoring and real-time congestion-management framework. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
